_: NOTES-FROM-PLANNING.md entry 242: every feature GroupLab has, the one source for grouplab.org/features/ and its spotlight. Each feature names the build it arrived in and a phrase from that build's release note, which the site's build finds in docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md or fails. From checkedFrom on, every note under What you will notice either belongs to a feature here or is listed in notFeatures.
notFeatures: Opening a second target and analyzing it

features.name: A GroupLab sheet reads itself
features.sentence: A printed GroupLab sheet names itself from its codes and is measured from its own markers, so nothing is set by hand.
features.note: A real scanned sheet is included in the download

features.name: Every hole found, and every one yours to change
features.sentence: Holes are found for you, and any one can be moved, added, removed, called a flyer or given a note.
features.note: You can now click a hole to edit it

features.name: The bulls you aimed at
features.sentence: Say which bulls you fired at, by rows, columns or a list, and each shot is measured from the bull it was aimed at.
features.note: You can now tell GroupLab which bulls you aimed at

features.name: A sheet shot off by the same amount
features.sentence: When every shot on a sheet of one shot per bull landed off by the same amount, as an unzeroed rifle does, each goes to the bull it was fired at.
features.note: When every shot on a sheet of one shot per bull landed off by the same amount

features.name: Targets GroupLab did not print
features.sentence: On any other target you place the bulls by hand, draw a scale at each one, and keep the layout as a template for the next sheet.
features.note: On a target GroupLab did not print, you can now place each bull by hand

features.name: Open by dropping or pasting
features.sentence: A target opens by dropping its picture on the window or pasting it, a screenshot or an image copied from a browser included.
features.note: You can now open a target by dropping the image on the GroupLab window

features.name: The figures you read off a target
features.sentence: The analysis leads with the figures a shooter reads off a target and the zero correction in inches, MOA and mil with the clicks to dial.
features.note: The analysis screen shows the six figures you read off a target

features.name: CEP circles, any percent
features.sentence: CEP 50, 90, 95 and 99 are drawn and listed with their ranges, and under Advanced a circle for any percent you type.
features.note: The analysis screen can now draw and list CEP 99

features.name: Every figure explained
features.sentence: Every figure can say what it means in a few plain sentences, including what having only a few shots does to it.
features.note: Every figure on the analysis page can now tell you what it means

features.name: Compare loads honestly
features.sentence: Compare loads draws each load's figures with the range they could really be, so you can see whether the shots can tell two loads apart.
features.note: Compare loads now draws each load's mean radius and sigma

features.name: Sessions over time
features.sentence: Every analysis is kept as a session, and one load's sessions are drawn over time with whether they really show it getting better.
features.note: The Session records screen now draws one load's sessions over time

features.name: Ballistics and hit chances
features.sentence: The Ballistics screen draws the trajectory and works out your chance of a hit from your own measured group.
features.note: The Ballistics screen now works out your chance of a hit

features.name: Shots in and out as CSV
features.sentence: Shot coordinates export as a CSV file for a spreadsheet, and import from other target software's CSV.
features.note: Shot coordinates can be exported as a CSV file

features.name: The Targets screen
features.sentence: Choose a sheet from the library and everything it takes to print it at its true size is beside the list.
features.note: The target library and printing are now one screen, Targets

features.name: Made for your optic
features.sentence: Give the distance, your lowest magnification or a red dot's size and the number of shots, and GroupLab draws bulls you can center on through that optic.
features.note: Design your own sheet can now make a sheet for your optic

features.name: Zeroing grids read through a scope
features.sentence: The zeroing grids are drawn to be read through a scope, with heavier lines at every half and whole unit and the scale printed on the sheet.
features.note: The four zeroing grids are redrawn to be read through a scope

features.name: Large sheets
features.sentence: For a target larger than a scanner takes, the Targets screen says whether a phone photograph of it has enough detail, and a tiled target prints on one large page with cut lines.
features.note: For a target larger than a scanner takes

features.name: Real inches from a scan
features.sentence: A scan measures how large the sheet was really printed and corrects every size, so a sheet your printer shrank still measures right.
features.note: A scanned target now reports real inches

features.name: Photographs at an angle
features.sentence: A photograph is measured at the angle it was taken, up to a limit GroupLab measured, and refused past it with the angle named.
features.note: A photograph taken more than 40 degrees off square to the sheet is now refused

features.name: Sessions between phone and computer
features.sentence: A session is shared as one file and opened on the phone or another computer, picture and marking together.
features.note: You can share a session with the new Share a session file
features.noPicture: it happens between two devices, and the phone's screens come with its look (entry 243)

features.name: The phone follows your region
features.sentence: On the phone, units follow the phone's region, yards and inches in the United States.
features.note: On the phone, units now follow the phone's region
features.noPicture: a phone screen, which comes with the phone's look (entry 243)

features.name: Send a target to the project
features.sentence: After an analysis GroupLab can send the target to the project to improve detection, asking first unless you choose otherwise.
features.note: After you analyze a target, GroupLab now offers to send it to the project

features.name: Error reports
features.sentence: When GroupLab hits an error it can send a report so the problem can be fixed, automatically, after asking, or never.
features.note: GroupLab can now send a report when it hits an error

features.name: The hardware survey
features.sentence: If you say yes, GroupLab reports what it runs on and how fast, and the published figures count every computer once.
features.note: GroupLab now asks once whether you would like to take part in the hardware survey

features.name: Words explained where they appear
features.sentence: Words like sigma, CEP, MOA and bull are underlined with dots in GroupLab and on the website; point at one for a plain explanation.
features.note: Words like sigma, CEP, MOA and bull are underlined with dots

features.name: Updates that list what you skipped
features.sentence: GroupLab updates itself, and the update bar lists every build you skipped, newest first, with what each changed.
features.note: the update bar now lists every build you skipped
features.noPicture: the update bar appears only when a newer build exists, which the screenshot walk never has

features.name: Builds for the Mac
features.sentence: Every nightly is built for Apple silicon and Intel Macs as well as Windows and Linux.
features.note: GroupLab now publishes Mac builds
features.noPicture: the Mac builds look like the others; it is a platform, not a screen

features.name: Pool the sheets of a set
features.sentence: The sheets of a set from Made for your optic are read in any order and pooled into one group, and GroupLab says which sheets are still missing.
features.note: pool

features.name: The E bull
features.sentence: Three sheets carry a bull you can center on through a scope at 10x: a black disc with a white center and a small dot.
features.note: three sheets with a new bull

features.name: The C bull
features.sentence: A black diamond standing on a point, with a white center and a dot: its points sit on a crosshair's lines, on three sheets and in the designer and Made for your optic.
features.note: the C bull

features.name: Large format on a home printer
features.sentence: The large format sheets print as sets of four Letter or A4 sheets, the same bulls and spacing, each sheet with its own markers and codes.
features.note: sets of four Letter or A4 sheets

features.name: GroupLab Dev for testers
features.sentence: A development build installs beside GroupLab from Google Play, so a tester can have both on one phone.
features.noPicture: a phone build, whose screens come with the phone's look (entry 243)
features.note: GroupLab Dev

features.name: The sheet beside the numbers on a big screen
features.sentence: On a tablet in landscape or an unfolded phone, the result shows the sheet and its numbers side by side instead of one under the other.
features.noPicture: a phone build, whose screens come with the phone's look (entry 243)
features.note: side by side

features.name: Print a sheet from the phone
features.sentence: The phone has a Targets screen: the whole library and Made for your optic, printed through Android's own print dialog or shared as a PDF.
features.noPicture: a phone build, whose screens come with the phone's look (entry 243)
features.note: Targets screen
